data_description.dataset_name: Geomorpho90m First order derivatives: Stream Power Index (SPI)

spatial_coverage.region_name: Global geomorphometric stream power index coverage
spatial_coverage.coverage: Global Geomorpho90m stream power index dataset in WGS84, organized as spatial tiles rather than a single monolithic raster.

data_description.temporal_coverage: Static geomorphometric stream power index tile collection derived from MERIT DEM; each image represents a spatial terrain tile rather than a time step.
data_description.temporal_unit: Not a temporal series; spatial tiles only
data_description.records: 1148 spatial stream power index tiles in collection

band_semantics.b1: Stream Power Index (SPI) raster for the spatial tile encoded by `system:index`. Measures erosive power of flowing water by combining upslope contributing area and local slope.

data_description.important_note: Description fields below were populated from an actual Earth Engine ImageCollection probe. The collection is organized as spatial stream power index tiles, not as a dated time series.

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Stream Power Index values calculated as the product of upslope contributing area and local slope; higher values indicate greater erosive power of flowing water.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Treat `system:index` values as tile identifiers and `pixel_resolution` as the spatial-resolution cue.

data_description.data_source: Yale University, Coillte, Irish State Forestry Board, Leibniz-Institute of Freshwater Ecology and Inland Fisheries, European Commission - Joint Research Centre, Spatial Ecology via Google Earth Engine Community Catalog
